sourcePredicates.publicBeforePrivate: Bootstrap verifies build/runtime/genesis and finalized historical/current unchanged deployment before reading wallet/role/password files or reserving private paths. Integration rechecks public recovery before reconstruction/restoration; driver reobserves deployment before first financial call.
sourcePredicates.fixedIdentity: Recovery validates exact original build, network configuration, public wallet identity, funded wallet paths and roles; original public plan and stopped reservation/result bytes are digest pinned. Live original reservation bytes must still match.
sourcePredicates.nativeState: Actual 11195-byte public fixture is decoded by installed ledger; exact native hash, both identifiers, sole deployment, address, fee, no unshielded input/output, consumed DUST nullifiers and whole initial ContractState hash are checked. Historical and latest state must retain constructor state and canonical finality.
sourcePredicates.constructor: Only unchanged constructor runs with admitted compiled assets, original roles/network, wallet coin public key and matching signing key. Full state serialization hash, maintenance authority, vacant private state and empty zswap local state must match before restoration. No deployment transaction is created in recovery branch.
sourcePredicates.store: Original stopped store is never opened by Level: empty directory is checked or an exclusive bounded copy inspected for exact metadata-only namespace. Destination must be fresh, private, empty and nonoverlapping; restore writes state/key serially and verifies both round trips. Trusted OS-account quiescence remains assumed.
sourcePredicates.noRedeployment: Recovery branch supplies no deployContract capability to driver; verified private results and driver recovery capabilities are single-use. New execution performs initialize, accrue, settle only.
sourcePredicates.accounting: New provider allocation remains exclusive, cumulative and fail closed. Old failed allocation and one same-bytes transport reservation remain preserved; conservative budget subtracts both reservations. Comparator counts accepted deployment native fee once as historical actual debit and caps new stages separately.
sourcePredicates.submission: Opt-in preview-ws reaches actual WalletFacade submissionService. One manually connected WS provider with auto reconnect false carries metadata and one submission; no send retry. Facade requests Finalized and returns last native identifier. Service requires successful indexed exact native hash/all identifiers, canonical inclusion and finality with canonical recheck. Timeout remains unknown and cannot cause late submission from a delayed connection. Recovery now requires explicit preview-ws at the shared closed-plan gate; defaults and HTTP cannot enter recovery.
sourcePredicates.completion: Full stage comparator, all historical/new identifiers, three current reservation count, retained historical marker, wallet persistence and cleanup plus durable public result and absolute-deadline CLI selector remain required. Outer containment and independent result audits remain separate.
